sql: SELECT pl.vendor_id, pl.period, SUM((pl.amount_cad) - (pl.qty * pl.contract_unit_price * pl.fx_rate)) AS excess_cad FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor v ON pl.vendor_id = v.vendor_id WHERE v.vendor_name = 'VEND-SNC' AND pl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09') GROUP BY pl.vendor_id, pl.period
